从零开始学塔罗，或带着今天的问题抽一组牌。: Learn tarot from the beginning, or draw cards for a question on your mind.
先看讲解，再试一题。学过的内容，下次接着来。: Read the explanation, then try a question. Pick up where you left off next time.
选一个想问的问题，洗牌、选牌，看看牌给你的回答。: Choose a question, shuffle and draw, then read the answer.
选择你感兴趣的牌，先学正位，再逐步认识逆位和不同情境。: Choose a card that interests you. Start upright, then explore reversals and different situations.
退出前不用额外保存，下次可以接着来。: Your progress saves automatically. Continue when you return.
以前的记录仍保留在备份中。现在可以从课程继续学习。: Earlier records remain in your backup. Continue learning with the courses.
先记住这张牌本来的意思，再结合具体问题看哪里发生了变化。逆位不一定表示坏事。: Keep the basic meaning in mind, then consider what changes in this situation. Reversed does not automatically mean bad.
